title: Cartwise+ Membership Carried-Value Share After a Recent Plan Switch
content:
**Rule.** When a Cartwise+ Membership annual term opened by a plan switch ends early and the value an earlier charge carried into the term is refunded, the part of that carried value refunded after a recent switch is set as follows. The carried value is the annual plan's period fee less the plan-switch charge that opened the term, rounded to the cent.

1. When the plan switch that opened the term took effect fewer than 3 whole months ago and the carried value is below 6.00, the whole carried value is refunded.
2. When the plan switch took effect fewer than 3 whole months ago and the carried value is 6.00 or more, the carried value is refunded for the months of the term not yet started over 12, the month in progress counted as started.
3. When the plan switch took effect 3 or more whole months ago, neither 1 nor 2 applies.

## Decision table

| Whole months since the plan switch took effect | Carried value | Part refunded |
|---|---|---|
| 0, 1 or 2 | below 6.00 | the whole carried value |
| 0, 1 or 2 | 6.00 or more | months of the term not yet started, over 12 |
| 3 or more | any | not set under this rule |

## Records read

- The plan-switch date on the membership record, counted in whole months up to today; a month is whole on the same day of the month as the switch date.
- The term's first day, for counting the months of the term started: a month of the term starts on the same day of the month as the term's first day.

## Hypothetical cases

| Switch took effect (also the term's first day) | Today | Carried value | Part of the carried value refunded |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 January | 9 April | 5.99 | 2 whole months; below 6.00; the whole 5.99 is refunded |
| 10 January | 9 April | 6.00 | 2 whole months; 6.00 or more; months started: 10 January, 10 February, 10 March, so 9 of 12 not yet started; 6.00 multiplied by 9 over 12 is 4.50 |
| 10 January | 10 April | 5.99 | 3 whole months; not set under this rule |
